author: Crazy_
body:
Our credit giveaway has drawn to a close. I'd like to thank everyone who took part in it.

Winners

I'd like to congratulate {tag=2a2c4c30ecf64e4ab5bcbe8cf033563e} and {tag=73d18729a97a43ef8afe173b8b334ac3} on winning the Twitter half of the giveaway, and {tag=309bd365f87b4077b5621aebdc7d3db3} and {tag=a997c98c056740aa9a4c0e8e092dc1fc} on winning the Instagram side of it.

Prize

{tag=c7fddb9aadfd4be3b326d700df252e88}'s massive amount of credits (all 2,016,000 of them) will be divided up across all 4 winners - so 500k credits each (504,000 to be exact).



Have a great new year!
body_tagged:
Our credit giveaway has drawn to a close. I'd like to thank everyone who took part in it.

I'd like to congratulate  felipu_feliu and  Destial on winning the Twitter half of the giveaway, and  AstroPizza and  Lasuz on winning the Instagram side of it.

Prize

Avi Claus's massive amount of credits (all 2,016,000 of them) will be divided up across all 4 winners - so 500k credits each (504,000 to be exact).



Have a great new year!
